items.mainDefect: add_members calls group.add for every username without checking existing membership, so re-adding an existing member triggers a duplicate GroupUser INSERT that raises RecordNotUnique and returns a 500.

secondary.defect: The client-side addMembers call has no error handler, so the server failure goes unnoticed by the admin.

items.mainDefect: remove_member uses group.users.delete, which skips the old cleanup, so a removed user's primary_group_id can still point at a group they no longer belong to.

secondary.defect: Deleting the join record directly can skip the user_count counter cache update, leaving group.user_count wrong.
The spec only checks group.users.count, so it can't catch these removal regressions.

items.mainDefect: The add_members/remove_member specs pass group_id straight to the controller, skipping routing and using the wrong parameter name, so they pass while real requests fail.

secondary.defect: The controller reads params group_id, but the member routes send the id as params[:id], so every real request fails with 400.

items.mainDefect: add_members and remove_member call params.require(:group_id), but the member routes deliver the group id as params[:id], so every real request fails with ParameterMissing (400).

secondary.defect: The frontend never handles the rejected AJAX promises, so these failures are invisible to the admin.
